$comment: Three hooks stood here and ran at authorship time: no-hand-edit.mjs refused an edit to generated state (law 27), `pnpm -s guards` reported a violation against the edit that caused it rather than against a batch (law 29), and check-authorship.mjs printed two questions when an edit landed on a file whose job is to detect a problem. Commit a3cf31b deleted tooling/architecture, tooling/hooks and tooling/verify, so all three shelled files that no longer exist. The guards hook exited 2 on MODULE_NOT_FOUND, and exit 2 is the blocking-error protocol -- so every Write and Edit in this repository was refused by a hook enforcing a rule whose implementation had been deleted. They are removed rather than repaired because there is nothing left for them to call. What remains is the formatter, which decides nothing and blocks nothing. Note what this file can no longer do: law 29 has no enforcement at authorship time and none at gate time either, and no wording here changes that.
